scope: Resolve the institutional photo-rights policy gap for an already approved Class I Van Dyck selection. Preserve the existing date selection and artwork identity.

record.priority: Existing approved Class I selection — Palm Sunday, 2026-03-29
record.decision: Preserve existing date-specific approval for Anthony van Dyck's Entry of Christ into Jerusalem; no replacement, new rating, or placement change.

painting.title: Entry of Christ into Jerusalem
painting.institution: Indianapolis Museum of Art at Newfields

identity.evidence: GAC source names title, Van Dyck, ca. 1617, oil on canvas, Newfields, and accession 58.3. This is the same object identified by B04, not a new candidate.

image.existingImageMetadata: 5043 × 3325; 2.84 MB; exact source file aspect ratio matches the canvas at 1.517. B04 reports IMA accession 58.3 in file metadata.
image.institutionalOpenAccessRoute: Newfields' official licensing page states that downloadable public-domain collection image files are available through its Open Access program as high-resolution JPEGs, with no restrictions or conditions and no further permission or paperwork required.
image.objectSpecificAvailability: The legacy IMA object page was not accessible to the web browser in this pass, and the current Newfields collection portal did not expose a searchable result for accession 58.3. Therefore the precise Newfields Open Access download button/file for this object was not confirmed.
image.cropQa: Canvas and B04 source have matching wide ratio; no actual source pixels inspected. Preserve full panorama and avoid center crop.

rights.painting: Underlying painting is public domain; the GAC record labels its image rights Public Domain.
rights.existingCommonsPhoto: B04 verifies image-level PD-Art / Public Domain Mark for a faithful reproduction, but Commons warns protection status can differ by jurisdiction. This remains a jurisdiction-specific image route and is not upgraded to globally unrestricted.
rights.newfieldsPhotoPolicy: The museum states it does not claim copyright in the IMA-created artwork image files, and that its downloadable public-domain Open Access files may be used without restriction or conditions. This is strong official source-policy evidence.
rights.rightsStatus: Open Access reuse policy verified for eligible Newfields public-domain image files, but eligibility and an exact 58.3 file route were not confirmed. Keep this selection's reproduction rights conditionally open until the object-specific Open Access label is verified. Do not infer that all linked photos are open.
rights.attributionIfNewfieldsFile: Courtesy of the Indianapolis Museum of Art at Newfields.
